summary: Iteration 34: Verified (1) crush_feature admin flag + backend gate, (2) new glassmorphic Discover action dock, (3) Chat/Matches tab sync end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed (auth, feature-flags GET/PUT/persistence/invalid-key, crush 403-when-off / works-when-on / self-crush, conversations, matches, active-users, conversation payload shape). Frontend: login -> Discover dock (Pass/SuperLike/Like, no Crush when OFF; Crush appears when ON, order pass->superlike->like->crush, verified computed backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(1.5), rgba(0,0,0,0.35) bg, pill radius, glass border; like 66px > pass 56px > superlike/crush 46px), Admin Settings 'Secret Crush' toggle row present, clicking it flips UI state, fires toast 'crush feature disabled!' and persists to DB (verified via API). Matches page: Matches (2) with 2 match-cards, Messages tab loads 2 message-cards with preview + unread badge + online status, Active (1) with 1 active-user-card. Chat E2E: opened /chat/<match_id>, sent message, it rendered in thread and conversation preview updated to 'You: TEST_iter34 sync check'. All 3 requested features work as specified.

critical.issue: Intermittent 500. Confirmed root cause in backend.err.log: pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError E11000 on collection 'installs', index installation_id_1. The find_one-then-insert_one flow is not atomic, so two concurrent first-open calls with the same installation_id race and the second insert throws unhandled. Reproduced twice during frontend runs (console error visible on app load). Fix: replace find_one+insert_one with a single update_one(..., {'$setOnInsert': {...}, '$set': {'last_active_at': now}}, upsert=True), or catch DuplicateKeyError and return already_tracked.

minor.issue: DEFAULT_FEATURE_FLAGS is only applied when no document exists. The existing document is returned as-is, so newly added flags are silently missing from the response. Current response omits new_user_notif_to_males and new_user_notif_to_females entirely (they default to True in code but are absent in DB). Admin UI will render them as OFF and DiscoverPage-style `!!res.data?.flag` checks will read undefined->false. Fix: return {**DEFAULT_FEATURE_FLAGS, **stored_flags}.

No admin auth guard. Both endpoints were toggled successfully with plain unauthenticated curl (no token/header). Any anonymous caller can enable/disable referral_system, daily_rewards, ai_chatbot and crush_feature globally. Other admin routes use an admin middleware; this one appears exempt.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px width the third tab is clipped by the container right edge - it renders as 'Activ...' cut off mid-word (label text is correct: 'Active (1)'). Needs horizontal scroll/shrink or shorter labels.

The 'Reward Claimed!' modal auto-opens over the Discover action dock on every fresh login and must be dismissed before any swipe action is possible. Not a blocker (dismissable) but it hides the newly designed dock on first paint.

issues: Crush button uses the same Heart icon as the primary Like button (amber heart vs green heart), which reads as a duplicate/secondary 'like' rather than a distinct action. The Admin panel uses a Flame icon for the same feature - use Flame (or Sparkles) on Discover for consistency and to disambiguate from Like.
Pass button (56px) is larger than SuperLike (46px) and sits leftmost; the visual hierarchy Like(66) > Pass(56) > SuperLike/Crush(46) is intentional and looks good, no change needed.
Reward modal and Out-of-Swipes modal have no data-testid, making them hard to assert on in automation.

Seeded messages render with mixed am/pm timestamps in a sequence that looks out of order (12:59 pm after 12:49 pm, then 03:16 am). Likely cross-day seed data rather than a sort bug, but consider showing a date separator between days.

action_items: Fix POST /api/analytics/track-install 500: use an atomic upsert with $setOnInsert (or catch DuplicateKeyError) instead of find_one + insert_one.
Merge DEFAULT_FEATURE_FLAGS over the stored document in GET /api/admin/feature-flags so newly added flags (new_user_notif_to_males/females) are returned.
Add admin authentication to GET/PUT /api/admin/feature-flags - currently togglable anonymously.
Fix tab strip overflow on MatchesPage at 390px (Active tab clipped).
Change Discover Crush button icon from Heart to Flame to match the admin panel and avoid confusion with the Like heart.
Optional: split /app/backend/server.py (8697 lines) into routers/modules; AdminDashboard.jsx is 1413 lines.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py track_install(): find_one -> insert_one is a TOCTOU race against a unique index on installation_id; must be an upsert.
server.py get_feature_flags(): defaults are only seeded on first-ever insert, so any future flag addition is invisible to clients until a PUT writes it. Always merge defaults on read.
server.py feature-flags routes lack the admin auth dependency used by other /admin routes - privilege escalation for a global kill-switch.
DiscoverPage.jsx: crushEnabled is fetched inside the useEffect keyed on [cityFilter], so the feature-flag request is re-issued on every city filter change. Move it to a mount-only effect.

DiscoverPage.jsx handleAction('crush') intentionally does not advance the card (returns early). This is a reasonable choice but means users can only crush the currently visible profile; confirm this is the intended UX.
MatchesPage.jsx has 3 unused eslint-disable directives (lines 377, 392, 415) - remove them.
server.py is 8697 lines - well past the 700-line guideline; extract admin, chat, and analytics routers.

rca_of_the_issue: track-install 500: POST /api/analytics/track-install does find_one({installation_id}) then insert_one(). MongoDB has a unique index installation_id_1 on dating_app_db.installs. When the SPA fires the install-tracking call twice concurrently on first open (observed on app bootstrap), both requests miss the find_one and the second insert_one raises pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError E11000, which is unhandled and surfaces as HTTP 500 plus a browser console error. Repro: two parallel POSTs with the same fresh installation_id. Mitigation: single atomic update_one with upsert=True and $setOnInsert for the immutable fields.
